_doc: REVIEWED sessions on which a symbol legitimately has NO bars (a trading halt, a suspension): the live top-up / backfill continuity rule then does not require them. Each entry needs symbol, session (ISO date), reason, added (ISO date) and reviewed_by; a missing field refuses to load. HOW TO USE: when the log says 'Alpaca has no bars for session(s) [...]' for a symbol, check that the symbol was really halted that day (exchange notice), then add {"symbol": "XYZ", "session": "2026-10-20", "reason": "LULD halt all day, NYSE notice", "added": "2026-10-24", "reviewed_by": "you"} to 'entries' and reload; the next read appends. Never add a session just to silence an error.
